Payloads from the Claude desktop app's Code tab on Windows (bundled Claude Code 2.1.295,
`permission_mode: auto`, hooks registered in user settings). The user name is replaced with
`user` and the account and organization ids in scratch-workspace paths with placeholder
UUIDs. `PermissionDenied.json` is a real auto mode denial of an environment variable dump
(see docs/findings.md F-004 and F-013).
